sources.title: Pokémon TCG: Platinum—Supreme Victors official Card-Dex
sources.verification: The Claydol Antique Magic text places three damage counters on any Pokémon, both the player's and the opponent's, in any way the player likes.
sources.supportsZh: 作为双方公开场上固定总额指示物分配的历史卡文建模用例；不表示 Claydol 或任何历史卡已经可在本模组对战。

sources.title: Play! Pokémon Competitive Pokémon Rules and Formats
sources.verification: The official index provides maintained entry points for rulebooks, tournament rules, legality notices and errata.
sources.supportsZh: 用于持续核验当前规则包；索引页本身不被当作历史单卡的完整时序裁定。

retrievalLimitations: No PTCG Live behavior, Chinese translation, image or community source is used as rule authority.
The Card-Dex is used as a historical international text example, not a current Standard legality assertion.
Every real card remains unavailable until its complete official text, timing and legality are audited.
implementationLimits: Supports only exact placement of new damage counters across publicly visible in-play Pokémon with SELECT_ANY_POKEMON plus ANY_FIELD.
The server issues candidates and revalidates target identity, ownership, counts and total before applying all placements.
Does not implement moving counters, removal, replacement effects, card-rule filtering, complex source restrictions or the historical Claydol card.
